content:
priya: noticed partner S3 bucket contains multiple KMS-wrapped files that look like Vault-wrapped blobs. attaching sample log line and sizes.
priya: sample \n``n2026-03-20T14:02:11Z GET /partner-backups/2026-03-19/creds.enc 200 - user:svc-partner-sync agent:okHttp\nmetadata: kms_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-01, ciphertext_size=4096\n``\n
matt: wrap-key-01 is the one we use for Vault transit rewraps. treat as sensitive; assume anyone with decrypt on that key could unwrap these.
sam: triage steps: 1) snapshot KMS and storage access logs; 2) revoke Vault leases possibly referenced by these blobs; 3) temporarily restrict decrypt perms on the key; 4) copy affected objects to sec-bucket for forensic imaging.
jen: +1. Also: enable extended audit export for the key and Vault admin paths to a long-retention bucket while we investigate. priya, do we know if partner-side was intentionally writing wrapped creds or was it a misconfigured backup? @alice?
alice: the partner-sync lambda was meant to back up metadata only. looks like a config change last week started including full credential blobs. I'm checking commit history and lambda environment variables now.
security-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03-20-001 (severity: medium) - runbook applied: kms-wrap-leak.
oncall: I'm on standby. any RBAC changes involving KMS should be coordinated to watch for Vault failures.
priya: initial findings: ciphertexts span 03-17..03-19, same ciphertext size pattern as Vault-wrapped corp secrets. no external IAM principals except svc-partner-sync were observed in the last-hour access logs.
matt: can we map ciphertext to Vault lease/token? Suggested commands:
```
# do not unwrap on prod host; use lookup APIs where possible
vault list sys/leases/lookup | grep partner-sync || vault operator step-down
# dry-run rewrap to inspect metadata shape
vault operator rewrap -ciphertext-file sample.ct --dry-run
```
sam: don't perform actual unwrap on internet-connected box. create an isolated forensic host with no egress. Prefer to revoke leases by path if mapping exists:
```
vault leases lookup -prefix secret/data/partners || vault lease revoke -prefix secret/data/partner-sync
```
jen: RBAC proposal: remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from partner service account immediately. Create an incident-unwrap@redwood SA with just-in-time permissions to decrypt for controlled analysis, restricted to our CIDR and timeboxed key binding.
priya: opening GCP IAM change request now: revoke decrypt from svc-partner-sync@55555, grant decrypt to incident-unwrap@redwood with expiration 2 hours. ETA ~25m.
alice: I've told partner to pause backup uploads and to roll back the change. will provide the list of S3 object keys that match the pattern in 10-15m.
security-bot: audit logs archived to gs://redwood-sec-audit/INC-2026-03-20-001/ and notification sent to security-alerts.
sam: also recommend scanning other buckets for KMS-wrapped patterns: use `aws s3api list-objects` + grep for "kms_key=projects/redwood" in logs or object metadata, and copy any hits to sec-bucket for later analysis.
matt: once IAM deny is applied, plan a controlled decrypt using incident-unwrap SA on an isolated host. document chain-of-custody and capture stdout/stderr. only reveal plaintext to legal if needed.
priya: additional step: flag any long-lived Vault tokens issued in the last 7 days with access to partner paths; revoke if TTL > 1h. will run a token audit.
oncall: if we need legal or partner-relations, escalate. keep me updated.
alice: partner confirmed pause and shared manifest of object keys over DM. they will also share commit that enabled the full-blob backup.
jen: note: IAM changes may not take effect immediately due to caching; plan for a 5-10 minute drift. monitor Cloud KMS:true decrypt attempts and Vault errors closely.
priya: action items summary:
- priya: run Vault lease queries + revoke relevant prefixes (ETA 20m)
- matt: draft IAM denylist PR for wrap-key-01 (ETA 25m)
- sam: provision isolated forensic host and incident-unwrap SA with time-limited key access (ETA 30m)
- jen: configure CloudAuditLogs export to secure bucket and set retention (ETA 45m)
- alice: confirm partner paused and provide object key list (ETA 15m)

priya: posting updates here after lease revokes and IAM change. thanks all :thumbsup:
